transformation: Original decoded 448-cache RGB -> OpenCV8bit LAB -> CLAHE on L only, clipLimit2.0, tileGrid8x8 -> RGB. Restore all original pixels whose maxRGB<=10. No learned image/dataset statistics; no geometric alteration. Apply before existing320/448 Resize and ImageNet normalization. Source images unchanged.
extraction: Strict original DINOv3-B16 weights, frozen eval AMPfloat16, only2091developmentimages. Same finalCLS,3x3regions,block7midpatchmean and patchstd. Six unchanged images reproduce M5 pipeline; every shard audited and six corrected actual images re-forwarded with a fresh model before fitting.
fusion: Each photometric view contains its own320+448 channels. Concatenation uses original M5 attention. Shared controls independently encode the two1536-channel photometric views with tied M5-style projections, then average or use an image-dependent reliability softmax. No new view auxiliary or consistency losses.
training: Each fixed configuration3formal+3foldx3seed heads, original M5 task losses,hparams,patientweights and stopping. Feature normalization fit inside each fit; external rows NaN.
selection: Patient CV Macro-F1 above M5 and original validation Macro-F1 no decrease; freeze any qualifier before fresh patient confirmation versus M5 and fixed Gaussian. No automatic external evaluation.
external_test_policy: No new external image extraction, predictions or outcomes; no external sources used to choose illumination transform or fusion.
